The '''Model 58''' was a model of [[Holster/Legends|holster]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
A compact holster built for small firearms, the Model 58 was designed to fit to the contours of the wearer's body and to mask the presence of a weapon from even the most determined surveillance scans. Model 58's came in a variety of forms, and could be worn high on the belt, under the arm, in the small of the back, or on an ankle or other extremity; however, the holster could only conceal light [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blasters]].<ref name="DC" />
